question: How are the season and half-year paired with the goddesses named here?
premises: Ṛtu is named as a time unit.
Parameśvaryau are mentioned as a pair.
inference: The season is paired with the two supreme goddesses and Kālī is joined with the half-year.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of the dual parameśvaryau to ṛtu is not fully explicit.
